column1: # Frozen settings for the C4 nested-coverage leave-zero-out experiment (review round 8). Committed before any
# read is simulated for it. The 30x milestone settings (tests/genotype_frozen_settings_r6.tsv) and every earlier
# result are unchanged; this experiment writes its own directories.
# Reads are simulated ONCE per donor at source_coverage with the new seed below, and every lower coverage is a
# nested subset of that simulation: genotype_probe subsample keeps a paired fragment when a hash of its name
# falls below coverage/source_coverage, so each set is contained in every higher one and coverage is not
# confounded with a fresh draw. The declared fragment-start intensity follows the coverage.
# Both arms are ranked from one proposal and one scoring pass per donor and coverage: the panel arm (K = 0,
# every panel diplotype) and the mosaic arm (K = 8 off-panel mosaics), with the predeclared K = 256 phase audit.
# No LOWCONF threshold is applied: none has been frozen, and conditional GQ is reported per arm.
# Donor roles come from tests/genotype_development_donors.tsv unchanged: the eight development donors are run
# first, and the 56 held-out donors only afterwards.
# Review round 9: the driver now passes every parameter below explicitly instead of relying on simulator
# defaults, and salts both the simulation seed and the thinning selector with the donor name, so donors no longer
# share one random stream. The values are unchanged from the completed C4 run, whose simulations used the same
# numbers through the defaults; that run remains one frozen realization per donor from a shared stream.
